title: The Choice Compass
learning_focus: Concepts and benefits of preventing early pregnancy; goals, responsibility, and age-appropriate decision-making.
story_premise: A future-planning fair is disrupted by rumors that pressure young people to make unsafe choices. The player restores a compass pointing toward health, education, relationships, and long-term goals.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Concepts and benefits of preventing early pregnancy; goals, responsibility, and age-appropriate decision-making.

areas.title: Goals Gate
areas.story: Connect present choices with education, health, and personal goals. Recognize that decisions can affect multiple people and future options.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: A health or safety concern is affecting Goals Gate.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Connect present choices with education, health, and personal goals.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Observe the signs, think about Concepts and benefits of preventing early pregnancy, then apply the safest healthy action.

learning_clues: Health focus: Concepts and benefits of preventing early pregnancy.
Observe signs, context, and available trusted support before acting.

questions.prompt: What is the healthiest first response in Goals Gate?

options.text: pause, observe the situation, and choose a safe action related to Concepts and benefits of preventing early pregnancy
Ignore the signs and continue the unsafe behavior.
Copy another person without checking the situation.
Hide the problem and avoid trusted help.

questions.first_wrong_hint: Use the visible health clues before deciding.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: The safe first step is to pause, observe the situation, and choose a safe action related to Concepts and benefits of preventing early pregnancy.
questions.correct_feedback: The safe first step is to pause, observe the situation, and choose a safe action related to Concepts and benefits of preventing early pregnancy.

questions.prompt: Health clues should be observed before the learner chooses an action.

options.text: True
False

questions.first_wrong_hint: Think about why the NPC, environment, or body signal is shown.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: The statement is true: the clues provide the reason for the healthy or safe choice.
questions.correct_feedback: The statement is true: the clues provide the reason for the healthy or safe choice.

questions.prompt: Select the two actions that support a safe and healthy decision.

options.text: Use the observed clues.
Choose a safe action or ask a trusted person for help.
Ignore warning signs.
Repeat an unsafe choice to see what happens.

questions.first_wrong_hint: Choose actions that reduce risk and use reliable support.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: Safe decisions use evidence from the situation and appropriate help when needed.
questions.correct_feedback: Safe decisions use evidence from the situation and appropriate help when needed.

questions.prompt: What should happen after the learner answers the situation questions?

options.text: Apply the healthy action in the game world and observe the result.
Collect the symbol without helping the NPC or area.
Restart the entire mission after one mistake.
Upload the static question text to the server.

questions.first_wrong_hint: PE & Health requires an applied action, not only a quiz answer.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: The correct choice must be applied in the world so the learner sees its effect.
questions.correct_feedback: The correct choice must be applied in the world so the learner sees its effect.

areas.world_action: Apply a safe, age-appropriate action demonstrating Concepts and benefits of preventing early pregnancy.
areas.world_result: The NPC or environment in Goals Gate visibly improves after the healthy action.
